description: A tall, imposing human warrior in full plate armor, standing with a zweihander held in both hands. The armor is muted grey steel with worn edges and scuffed joints, catching flat, hand-placed highlights; the blade is long and broad, its polished steel broken by faint scratches and a dulled edge. The figure dominates the cell with a strong silhouette, the only real outline in the set.
name: Zweihander human warrior
